tellings.question: What do you remember about teaching Ben to ride a bike?
tellings.text: It was a blue bike with a bell, two sizes too big because I said he would grow into it. I ran behind him holding the seat up and down the whole street. When I finally let go he didn't notice for half a block.

tellings.question: Dad says you didn't notice when he let go. Is that true?
tellings.text: I just didn't want to stop, because stopping meant falling. I noticed. I rang the bell the whole way to the corner so he would know I was fine.
